data.name: Saheb
data.gender_notes: Saheb is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Saheb is recorded with the meaning “Master, Lord”. Saheb is a Hindu name meaning “Master, Lord”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saheb expresses “Master, Lord”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: Saheb
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Master, Lord
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saheb एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who holds or manages a property or business, a leader or a master

in_hindi.name: साहेब
in_hindi.long_meaning: The master, the lord, the owner, the boss

in_tamil.name: Saheb
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Master, Lord
in_tamil.long_meaning: Saheb ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who holds or manages a property or business, a leader or a master

in_telugu.name: Saheb
in_telugu.long_meaning: Saheb ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who holds or manages a property or business, a leader or a master

in_marathi.name: Saheb
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saheb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds or manages a property or business, a leader or a master

in_bengali.name: Saheb
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Master, Lord
in_bengali.long_meaning: Saheb একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds or manages a property or business, a leader or a master
